messages:
Alex: FYI — running into another json-mode streaming issue in the samplekit onboarding. js helper is emitting an extra separator between consecutive function-call objects so the server-side strict schema validator fails. short repro and logs below.

Alex: repro (ts):
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ jsonMode: true, streaming: true });
await client.chat.complete({
  model: 'rw-mini',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'run sequence' }],
  functions: [
    { name: 'a', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { v: { type: 'number' } }, required: ['v'] } },
    { name: 'b', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { w: { type: 'number' } }, required: ['w'] } }
  ]
});
```

Alex: stream chunks (observed):
```
chunk1: '{"name":"a","arguments":{"v":1}}'
chunk2: ','
chunk3: '{"name":"b","arguments":{"w":2}}'
assembled: '[{"name":"a","arguments":{"v":1}},,{"name":"b","arguments":{"w":2}}]'
validator error: Unexpected token , in JSON at position 34
```

Priya: ouch. that double-comma is wild. which sdk and samplekit?

Alex: js-sdk@0.8.1, samplekit v0.15, reproduces both on local and the cloud quickstart. py-sdk not affected (partner reported parity).

Noah: likely the streaming serializer writes separators both at end of object and as a separate chunk when it flushes boundaries. race between object-close and separator-emission.

Priya: can you check whether the serializer uses a separate flush() call that emits ',' and the finalizer also emits ','? if so add idempotency.

Alex: confirmed. helper calls "emitSeparator()" from two code paths in edge case when back-to-back function outputs are produced by model. patch idea: only emit separator if buffer.length > 0 and lastChar !== ',' && lastChar !== '['.

Noah: also add an integration test that simulates back-to-back function streams and compares final output to expected JSON array. add test in samplekit/tests/streaming.spec.ts.

Alex: opened PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/205 (fix + test). includes a tiny shim in sdk/streaming/serializer.ts.

ops-bot: ci 12: samplekit-integration build #78 failed (logs: https://ci.internal/samplekit/78)

Priya: CI failed on an unrelated lint rule in a preexisting file, bumped to flaky CI triage. re-triggering.

ops-bot: ci 12: samplekit-integration build #79 succeeded

Noah: once PR lands, let's cut a patch release to the samplekit and publish a temporary note in the onboarding docs about using "--no-stream" for users hitting strict validators.

Priya: +1. also propose adding a one-line tolerant parse on the server side during onboarding that strips duplicate commas and weird trailing separators for the first-week experience. must be opt-in and behind a flag.

Alex: temporary server-side tolerance helps but we should fix at the serializer. shipping a looser server parser would hide other bugs.

Priya: understood. prioritizing serializer fix. scheduling a small doc blurb and a changelog entry for the next samplekit release. :memo:
